records.reason: Paired conditioning silicone fluid and dimethiconol gum route supports a cohesive retained system; mobile hydrocarbons/ether are distribution counter-signals, not film erasers.

Dimethicone/dimethiconol provide substantive retained-film interpretation in aqueous/solvent delivery. PEG14 and PQ7 add conditioning clues without automatic gum/adhesion attribution; polyacrylamide is rheology.
Retained botanical lipid system supports ordinary oil coating. Lecithin stability and aromatic/extract gaps do not establish a cohesive/adherent film; small amount is context rather than a low rule.

Mobile esters/alkane and ordinary oils support a fluid emollient remainder. Exact hydrogenated coco-glyceride film-forming capability is a real high counter-signal, but not affirmative whole-system structured dominance from presence/rank alone; its grade and contribution remain undisclosed.
